template.title: Start from a template
template.body: Choose a protocol, enter the URL and key, then check the models.

assistant.title: Let local AI read the docs

paste.title: Use your own AI

channels.analysisApprovalBody: Send redacted documentation from {{source}} to {{model}}. Model fees may apply. One call only; invalid output is not automatically repaired or retried. Review and save the result manually. No generation test is run.

smoke.title: Paid test run
smoke.entryHint: Separate from the free model-list check. Review real inputs and the request before approving one submit.
smoke.warning: This submits a real request to the channel and may incur charges. Output-count parameters apply. No automatic retries. Closing this window does not cancel an upstream task.
smoke.credentialUnavailable: The credential is unavailable or the vault is locked. Configure or unlock it in the channel first.
smoke.approval: Submit {{operation}} to {{model}} through {{channel}}. Verify the request on the right before approving.
smoke.invalidUrl: Enter an upstream-accessible HTTP(S) media URL without user credentials. Local files are not uploaded automatically.
smoke.mimeRequired: Provide a MIME type for every reference.
smoke.previewHint: Uses the actual execution renderer. Credentials are masked and media bytes are summarized. Only real selected inputs are shown; no sample media is submitted.
smoke.noJob: No job ID was received. No automatic retry was made.
smoke.recover: Query or retrieve this job (never resubmit)
smoke.closeHint: This window cannot submit again. Closing only hides the window and does not cancel upstream billing. Copy the job ID first if needed.
smoke.modelImported: Model imported into the local model library: {{id}}

status.recoverable_wait: Query or download paused; the existing job can be retrieved
status.failed: Test run failed; no automatic retry
status.unknown: Submission outcome unknown. Check upstream records before a new submit; no automatic retry
status.canceled: Local task stopped; upstream cancellation is not implied

sceneBuilder.title: Build scene from images
sceneBuilder.help: Vision draft, local depth backdrop, or a real model channel. Keep editing while it runs.
sceneBuilder.applied: Added to the stage. Undo in one step with ⌘Z / Ctrl+Z.
sceneBuilder.oneImage: The local depth backdrop needs exactly one reference image.
sceneBuilder.draftNotice: The vision model turns images or a description into a draft using existing presets, not spatial reconstruction. Review the preview, scale, and uncertainty before applying.
sceneBuilder.descriptionHint: Describe the space, people, objects, and composition to preserve…

sceneBuilder.modelMissing: The generated model is missing from My Models. The stage was not changed.

sceneBuilder.recoverNotice: Retrieve this job after a reload. Query and recovery never submit a new job.

relief.downloadNotice: Runs locally without paid model calls. The first run downloads about 99 MB of model weights and 27 MB of runtime, then uses the browser cache.

knowledge.assetMissing: The dropped asset no longer exists. Choose it again.
knowledge.draftHint: Unsaved drafts stay in this session. Save writes the Markdown file.
